title: Security Logging, Monitoring, and Incident Response
learning_outcomes: Explain the main risks and boundaries covered by Security Logging, Monitoring, and Incident Response.
Choose defensive controls appropriate to the Security Logging, Monitoring, and Incident Response topics and document relevant assumptions.
Create or interpret evidence that verifies secure and denied/failure behavior in a controlled environment.
